items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: I got Duke, I got Otto and boy called Arthur Whetsol... All of them. The Washingtonians.

ctx.x: You know, so I go my way and have me some fun. I ain't paying anybody no mind. Because I'm way up on the hog, I'm making money. Pockets just laughing. And I wasn't married or nothing like that. I didn't know my wife existed then, anyway, Fats Waller came to town. I had been down there and I stayed down there about -- I had been down there about four years then. So Fats Waller came down there, to play Herdick & Seeman, burlesque house, he had them all over the country. Fats had a band played with the burlesque…
So anyway, he said I need five guys. I said I got them. I got Duke, I got Otto and boy called Arthur Whetsol played trumpet, call him 'Chief', and Elmer Snowden.
